items.title: "Wild" Bill Davison Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I am John Steiner and these are excerpts of my interview with Bill Davison...

ctx.x: I am John Steiner and these are excerpts of my interview with Bill Davison in November of 1961. Did you know the original Dixieland Jazz Band's records when you were a kid? Oh sure. You know them.
